audit.whatIsWrong: Layers disagreed at Level 6: full said Diana (7/10), content win[4] said Mel with a why written for level 5. Rows 0-3 and 5-6 were blanket 'Skill' on the full layer while content named sides.
audit.why: Diana's kill window opens at 6 — Moonfall (R, 100s) pulls and Lunar Rush resets off Moonlight; content's own spikes[1] says 'everything flips at 6'. Pre-6 melee Diana soaks Mel's 950-range poke; post-item her all-in is lethal. So Mel 1-5, Diana 6 onward.
audit.corrected: Content win[4] moved to Diana with a matching why; full rows 0-3 set Mel and 5-6 set Diana with grounded whys/ratings, all as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly called Lunar Rush her ultimate ('Lunar Rush (R)') in spikes[1], late, whys[5] and wants.foe[0]. Lunar Rush is her E dash; her R is Moonfall, the pull.
audit.why: Riot kit: E Lunar Rush (22s, no cooldown vs Moonlight targets), R Moonfall (100/90/80s, 475 range pull). The level-6 spike is Moonfall.
audit.corrected: All four fields rewritten with the correct names at the same length.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bullets were pasted tradeGood/tradeBad; dontsFull[1].d was generic projectile filler.
audit.why: Q Crescent Strike 8s rank 1 gates her engage; Lunar Rush 22s unmarked; Moonfall 100s gates the all-in. Rebuttal's immunity still matters vs her non-projectile dive even when nothing reflects.
